text:
sam: Snyk flagged a partner onboarding log with a long base64 blob that looks like a KMS-wrapped Vault token :grimacing:
sec-bot: created INC-2025-359 · severity: medium · assigned: eng-security
anika: sample: `PARTNER_SECRET="CiQX...wrappedpayload...=="` — vendor said it was a debug dump
leo: assume worst. isolate vendor bucket and export the line to a secure host for decrypt attempt. do not touch vendor infra
sam: copied ciphertext to secure-decrypt-01, running KMS decrypt under audit
leo: result -> plaintext reveals Vault accessor va_XYZ789 scoped to `secret/data/partner/onboard` with ttl 12h, renewable
anika: revoke accessor immediately and revoke any leases. create replacement token non-renewable and 30m TTL
leo: commands run: `vault token revoke -accessor va_XYZ789` then `vault token create -policy=partner-onboard -ttl=30m -period=0`
sec-bot: incident INC-2025-359 updated: status -> contained
sam: rotate wrapping key used by partner onboarding: create new key version, disable wrap on old version, notify partner to rewrap and resend via new secure flow
comms: I'll draft vendor notice and compliance memo. any user impact?
anika: none customer-facing. internal only. file for SOC review and schedule RBAC policy audit for `partner-onboard` next week
sam: follow-ups: add pre-ingest scrub to onboarding pipeline, add CI lint to block long base64 blobs in PRs, and add 90d audit retention for partner namespace
comms: noted, will assign legal review and send vendor template in 1.5h
leo: thanks team :lock:
